paragraphs: The XK 5.0 V8 uses the AJ133 — a 5.0-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol engine. It was fitted from 2005 to 2014 across the X150 generation. The AJ133 is part of Jaguar's third-generation AJ-V8 family, and its timing chain tensioner design is the subject of a documented class-action lawsuit covering this exact engine across multiple JLR models. The XK 5.0 V8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar XK 5.0 V8 Engine Compatibility The X150-generation XK 5.0 V8 uses the AJ133 engine throughout its production run. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XK 5.0 V8 from 2023 to present. The AJ133 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ133 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
